response_json.request: Add a 2 millimetre fillet to the edges of the scrolling wheel slot to ensure a smooth surface.

actions.target: Edges of the scrolling wheel slot
actions.relational_constraint: Apply the fillet to the housing slot opening edges where the top deck aperture boundary meets the pocket walls (top perimeter edge loop of the rectangular slot). Maintain clearance to the scroll-wheel/button insert by filleting only the housing solid (SOLID 0) edges at the slot mouth, not modifying the insert (SOLID 1).
actions.unresolved_reference: Interpreted as the user-touch/visible sharp edges at the slot mouth (top opening perimeter), not the deeper internal pocket-floor edges, to avoid interfering with the insert fit and motion.
steps: Activate/edit SOLID 0 (housing) features; suppress/hide SOLID 1 (scroll-wheel/button insert) for edge selection clarity and to ensure only the housing geometry is modified.
Identify the rectangular slot mouth edge-loop on the top deck face (face_code 0000) corresponding to the inner loop (aperture boundary) visible in the Top and TopRightIso views.

Create an edge selection set consisting of the four top perimeter edges formed by the intersection of the top deck face (0000) with each pocket wall face: (0000∩0006), (0000∩0007), (0000∩0008), (0000∩0009). Use an 'edge loop' or 'tangent chain' selection along the inner loop boundary; do not include any exterior housing edges.

Apply a constant-radius edge fillet feature with radius = 2.0 mm to the selected slot-mouth edges. Use a rolling-ball/standard fillet solution and enable corner blending (miter/rounded corner set to CAD default) so the four filleted edges transition cleanly around the rectangular corners.

If the fillet solver attempts to propagate onto unintended exterior edges due to tangency, constrain the selection to only the inner-loop edges of face 0000 and/or explicitly exclude exterior top-surface boundary edges.

Regenerate/validate: confirm the resulting fillet is continuous around the slot mouth, improves touch ergonomics (no sharp edge in Top/Front views), and does not intersect or reduce functional clearance for the insert (S7) within the pocket (S6).

intention: Ensure a smooth surface at the scrolling wheel slot by rounding its edges.
